title: Getting started with scpeaker
text: Within scpeaker package, provide general scpeaker() function perform CellChat CellPhoneDB analyses Seurat object. Importantly, scpeaker modify innate framework tools provide, returns original predictions infer. harmonising ligand-receptor databases, gene expression averaging strategy output format tools generate, scpeaker allows extract interactions significantly tested CellChat CellPhoneDB. Additionally, scpeaker accomodates arguments used statistical analysis CellChat CellPhoneDB within scpeaker() function. harmonised human ligand-receptor databases CellChat CellPhoneDB, providing scpeakerDB contains 3,901 non-redundant interactions manually curated original authors. , provide triMean gene expression averaging strategy CellPhoneDB match CellChat, allowing methods use robust mean method. Finally, optimise computational efficiency CellChat’s analysis, sped computeCommunProb() function used CellChat, reimplementing repeated calculating gene expression averages C++. may still opt execute original CellChat implemetation using fast.mode = FALSE.
